newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ELBER FACES FORMER CLUB IN LEAGUE CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ELBER FACES FORMER CLUB IN LEAGUE CUP FINAL.

text.p: Bayern Munich's new Brazilian signing Giovane Elber faces his former club Stuttgart in the final of the lucrative German League Cup tournament on Saturday.
Striker Elber, who joined champions Bayern from Stuttgart for 12.5 million marks ($6.9 million), faces a huge task in replacing Juergen Klinsmann, now with Sampdoria.
He made a promising debut on Wednesday by scoring a goal to help Bayern beat Borussia Dortmund 2-0 in a League Cup semifinal match.
Stuttgart were just as impressive in their semifinal, crushing Karlsruhe 3-0 on Tuesday to book a place in the final in Leverkusen's brand new stadium.
The League Cup, featuring the top six clubs of the last championship, replaces the traditional Supercup between the champions and the Cup winners as the curtainraiser to the new season.
The winner of Saturday's final will have cashed a total 2.5 million marks ($1.4 million) in prize money even before playing their first league match the following weekend.
Elber was not the only one to shine in Bayern's victory over European champions Dortmund. French international defender Bixente Lizarazu was also a key figure despite playing only 20 minutes.
Lizarazu, who joined from Athletic Bilbao, produced a perfect cross which defender Markus Babbel converted with a header for Bayern's second goal.

"I'm particularly pleased with the way the new players fitted in," said Bayern coach Giovanni Trapattoni. "They understood our system straight away and that's promising. But we haven't won anything yet. The real test is the final against Stuttgart and that will be tough."
Stuttgart, who came fourth in the last championship and won the German Cup, bought Nigerian striker Jonathan Akpoborie from Hansa Rostock after losing Elber.

The club from southern Germany, who kept Bulgarian playmaker Krasimir Balakov and international striker Fredi Bobic, are clearly aiming at the title, which will make Saturday's clash against Bayern even more intriguing.
